'''Yellow Nine Squadron''' comprised twelve<ref name="Starcave" /> [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] under the command of [[Yellow Nine Leader]] protecting a top secret [[Centrality Navy]] base conducting research into [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking]]<ref name="Starcave" /> technology in the [[Hosrel system/Legends|Hosrel system]]. While undergoing a routine patrol, they were alerted by their [[Unidentified Operator (Hosrel Perimeter Control)|Operator]] that a bandit had entered the system at coordinates three-five-oh-two-three<ref name="Starcave" />. Yellow Nine Leader requested a procedure six-sixty-six, scramble and visual checkout of an unidentified object. What they encountered, unbeknownst to them, was the [[Oswaft]] [[Lehesu]], who inadvertently caused [[Yellow Nine Seven]] to crash when it came into contact with his fins. The squadron regrouped and attacked where they believed Lehesu to be, but he had already jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] and [[Yellow Nine Four]] was caught in the crossfire. While returning to base, [[Yellow Nine Nine]] missed the mouth of the Launche/Reentry tunnel and collided with the face of a nearby mountainside.
